title: Uniqueness of the KPZ Fixed Point Among Scaling-Covariant Local Fields
exact_target: Do the specified locality and symmetry requirements characterize the KPZ fixed point uniquely among nontrivial space-time fields?

sources.citation: K. Matetski, J. Quastel, and D. Remenik, The KPZ fixed point, Remark 4.12, Acta Mathematica 2021.
